sahneler.metin: Before dawn in South Carolina, an Amtrak train slammed into a parked freight train.
Two crew members were killed, and more than a hundred people were hurt.
Signals on the line were suspended for work.
A freight train had been moved onto a siding.
The switch wasn't returned to the main line.
The Amtrak train was diverted straight into it.
The NTSB blamed poor risk assessment and a conductor's error.
Work zone protection came under scrutiny.

aciklama:
Cayce sent an Amtrak train into a parked freight. The cause: a conductor's error during a signal suspension without other protection.
